with עַלֿ‎ = above 25:21; 26:34 (P), = for, ׳נ עַלֿ גֹּרָלֹת‎ Lev 16:8 (P), cast lots for; = against Ezek 26:8; with אֶלֿ‎ into: ark into cart 1Sam 6:8, put one in the stocks Jer 29:26 (also with עַלֿ‎ 20:2), in prison 37:18; 38:11, compare Exod 25:16; 28:30 (P); put water upon (עַלֿ‎) something into (אֶלֿ‎) vessel Num 19:17; = toward אֶלעָֿקֹד הַצּאֹן מְּנֵי וַיִּתֵּן‎ Gen 30:40 (J; strike out Ol Di and others); with בְּ‎, cup into hand 40:13 (E), compare Judg 7:16, also Gen 41:48 (E), compare 1Kin 7:51; Gen 1:17 (P), 9:13 (P), 2Kin 19:18; Jer 27:8, ׳נ מֶּה בֶּעָפָר‎ Lam 3:29 (in figurative), בְּחֵיקֶ֑ךָ שִׁפְחָתִי נָתַתִּי‎ Gen 16:5 (J), וּבַדֶּלֶת בְאָזְנוֺ וְנָתַתָּה‎ Deut 15:17 and thou shalt put (the awl) into his ear and into the door (pin his ear to the door); put disease into one 7:15 (|| שִׂים‎); inflict blemish (מוּם‎) on (בְּ‎), Lev 24:19-20, בָּכֶם תִתְּנוּ לֹא קַעֲקַע וּכְתֹבֶת‎ 19:28; with בְּ‎ + בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם תִתְּנוּ לֹא לָנֶפֶשׁ שֶׂרֶט לְ,‎ 19:28 (all H); with לִטְנֵי‎ before, in front of, set food before one, 2Kin 4:43-44, compare Zech 3:9; Ezek 3:20; Exod 30:6; 40:5-6, (all P); with בֵּין‎ between, 30:18; 40:17 (P); with סָבִיב נ ׳מִגְרָעוֺת לַבַּיִת לְ,‎ 1Kin 6:6 he put ledges to the house; with other prepositions עִמָּדִי נָתַתָּ אֲשֶׁר הָאִשָּׁה‎ Gen 3:16 (J), the woman whom thou hast set at my side, compare Exod 31:6 (׳נ אִתּוֺ‎; figurative of association, assistance); with לִקְרַאת‎ Gen 15:10 (J), lay each piece to meet its fellow; he set the sea הַבַּיִת מִכֶּתֶף‎ 1Kin 7:39; with ה‎ locative put money שָׁמָּה‎ into it 2Kin 12:10, so of water Exod 30:18 (P), compare 40:7 (שָׁם‎); with 2 accusative נ ׳הַכְּלוּא בֵּית אוֺתוֺ‎ Jer 37:4 compare 37:15; put, place, absolute Exod 40:8 (P; || שִׂים‎, compare 26:32); set up, בְּ מַשְׂכִּית אֶבֶן‎ Lev 26:1 (H; || הֵקִים‎); + לְ‎ person, lay snare for me Psa 119:110 (in figurative).

b. figurative, in many phrase: with עַל‎, put my spirit upon him Isa 42:1, reproach upon one Jer 23:40, blessing on Mt. Gerizim, etc., Deut 11:29, curses on enemies 30:7; impose tax upon Neh 10:33 compare 2Kin 23:33; עַל הוֺד נָתַן‎ put majesty upon one 1Chr 29:25; Dan 11:21; Num 27:20 (P; מֵהוֺד‎; compare Psa 21:6); so also perhaps 8:2 hast set thy majesty upon (over) the heavens, compare ᵑ7 ᵑ9 ᵑ6‎ (read נָתַתָּה‎ for תְּנָה‎, Hup De Pe Bae and others; other views see in Thes Ew Ol Now Che We Du); = above, הָאָרֶץ עַלכָּֿלגּֿוֺיֵי עֶלְיוֺן וּנְתָ֑נְךָ‎ Deut 28:1; compare 26:19; put (something) over mouth Micah 3:5 (i.e. stop one's mouth, by a gift); = against ׳נ עַלֿ מָצוֺר‎ Ezek 4:2 (siege), compare 4:2 b; with אֶלֿ אֶתמָּֿנַי וָאֶתְּנָה לְבַקֵּשׁ ֗֗֗ אֲדֹנָי אֶלֿ,‎ Dan 9:3; with בְּ‎, words into mouth Deut 18:18; Jer 1:9, compare 1Kin 22:23; wisdom into heart, or person, 10:24; Exod 31:6; 36:1-2,(all P), compare Psa 4:8; set peace in earth Lev 26:6 (H); (the idea of) perpetuity (עוֺלָם‎) in heart Eccl 3:11; a purpose, נ ׳וּלהוֺדוֺת בְּלִבּוֺ‎ Exod 35:34 (P); בְּמִצְרַיִם אֶתיָֿדִי וְנָתַתִּי‎ 7:4 (P); עַמְּךָ בְּקֶרֶב נָקִי דָּם אַלתִּֿתֵּן‎ Deut 21:8; בְּעֵינֵי חִנּוֺ וַיִּתֵּן‎ Gen 39:21 (J), and he put his favour in the eyes of the prison-keeper (made the keeper favourable to him), compare Exod 3:21; 11:3; 12:36 (all E; compare also 1b, 3 b); with בְּ‎ person = against, in phrase set my face against, oppose Ezek 14:8; 15:7; Lev 17:10; 20:6 (both H); with בֵּין‎, = put, i.e. make a covenant between Gen 17:2 (P), compare Lev 26:46 (H); ׳נ לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶרֶץ‎ i.e. place at your disposal Deut 1:8, 21; compare 2:36; set ordinances, etc., before, לִפְנֵי‎ (for observance), 1Kin 9:6; Jer 26:4; 44:10; Dan 9:10; blessings and cursings (for choice) Deut 30:1, 15, 19; ׳נ פ בְּראֹשׁ ׳דֶּרֶךְ‎ set or place one`s way upon his head, i.e. requite him, Ezek 9:10; 11:21; 16:43; 22:31; compare 17:19, also 1Kin 8:32 2Chr 6:23 + (compare 1 v); י נִקְמַת ׳לָתֵת בְּמִדְיָן‎ Num 31:3 to set the vengeance of ׳י‎ upon Midian; ׳נ ׳ב‎ Psa 50:20 = set in, i.e. impute to (usually ב ׳שִׂים‎).

c. set, appoint, with accusative + עַלֿ‎ over, ׳י‎ hath set a king over you 1Sam 12:13 compare Gen 41:41 (E); with עַלֿ‎ on, עַלכִּֿסְאִי ׳נ ישֵׁב‎ 1Kin 1:48; with בְּ‎ in = over, 1Chr 12:9; Neh 13:4; with לְ‎ Nethînîm לַעֲבֹדָה‎ Ezra 8:20; with accusative alone, idol-priest 2Kin 23:5, prophet Jer 1:5 (2 accusative), leader Num 14:4; one instead of (תַּחַת‎) another 1Kin 2:35.

d. = assign, designate, with ׃לְ‎ God hath assigned victim-flesh to (ל‎) you, in order to bear sins of people Lev 10:17, compare Num 18:8 (both P); cities for (ל‎) flight of man-slayer 35:6 (P); לְכַמֵּר עַלהַֿמִּזְבֵּחַ לָכֶם נָתַתִּי‎ Lev 17:11 (H).

3 Make, constitute,

a. with 2 accusative, שָׂרֵיהֶם נְעָרִים וְנָתַתִּי‎ Isa 3:4 and I will make boys their princes, compare Gen 17:5; Exod 7:1 (both P), Psa 18:33 (> וַיַּתֵּר‎ in || 2Sam 22:33), 2Sam 39:6; 2Sam 69:12; 2Sam 135:12, etc.; + בֵּין‎ Josh 22:25 (P); + אֶלֿ‎ person עֹרֶף אֵלֶיךָ אֶתכָּֿלאֹֿיְבֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי‎ Exod 23:27 (E), and I will make all thine enemies unto thee a back, i.e. make them shew thee their back, flee from thee, so with לְ‎ Psa 18:41 = 2Sam 22:41.

b. with accusative + לְגַלִּים אֶתיְֿרוּשָׁלַיִם וְנָתַתִּי לְ,‎ Jer 9:10 and I will make Jerusalem into ruin-heaps, compare Deut 28:13; Isa 42:24; Gen 17:6, 20; 48:4; Num 5:21; Josh 17:3 (all P) +; ׳נ ׳פ לִפְנֵי לְרַחֲמִים‎ 1Kin 8:50 make persons an object of compassion before (in the eyes of), so Neh 1:11; Psa 106:46; Dan 1:9 (compare also 1b, 2 b); + לְ‎ person for (especially Jeremiah), הָאָרֶץ מַמְלְכוֺת לְכֹל לִזְוָעָה וּנְתַתִּים‎ Jer 15:4 and I will make them a terror for all kingdoms of the earth, compare 24:9; 29:18; 34:17.

c. with accusative + נ הָאֲרָזִים ׳וְאֵת כַּשִּׁקְמִים כְּ,‎ 1Kin 10:27 and the cedars he made like the sycomores, i.e. as common, = 2Chr 1:15, compare 1Kin 16:3; Ezek 28:6; Lev 26:19 (H), Ruth 4:11; כִּמְרַגְּלִים אֹתָנוּ וַיִּתֵּן‎ Gen 42:30 (E), i.e. regarded, treated us as spies, but insert ᵐ5 בַּמִּשְׁמָר‎ Ol Di Ball Holz, — בְּלִיַּעַל בַת לִפְנֵי אֶתאֲֿמָֽתְךָ אַלתִּֿתֵּן‎ 1Sam 1:16 difficult, (not withstanding Job 3:24; 4:19), read probably כְּ‎ (HPS), or לְ‎, for לִפְנֵי‎.

d. rarely with accusative alone: נ ׳לֹא עֶבֶד שְׁלֹמֹה יִשׂ ׳וּמִבְּנֵי‎ 1Kin 9:22 and of the sons of Israel Solomon made no slave, but read probably עֹבֵד לְמַס‎ (as 9:21; ᵐ5‎A ἐς πράγμα, omitted by B ᵐ5‎L; compare Klo Benz), קְהִלָּה עֲלֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן‎ Neh 5:7 and I made (held) over their case a great assembly; make a decree, חֹק‎, Psa 148:6; perhaps also בְּפַרְעֹה אֹתֹת וַתִּתֵּן‎ Neh 9:10 and thou didst perform signs and wonders against 'Pharaoh, etc. (compare בְּ אוֺתֹת שִׂים‎ Exod 10:2; Psa 78:43).

Niph`al82 Perfect נִתַּן‎ Isa 9:5 +; 3 feminine singular נִתְּנָה‎ Gen 38:14 +; 2 masculine plural וְנִתַּתֶּם‎ consecutive Lev 26:25; 1plural נִתַּ֫נּוּ‎ Ezra 9:7, etc.; Imperfect יִנָּתֵן‎ Exod 5:18 +, לוֺ יִנָּ֫תֶן‎2Chr 2:13 (Ginsb van d. H. יִנָּ֫תֶןלֿוֺ‎), etc.; Infinitive absolute הִנָּתֹן‎ Jer 32:4; 38:3; construct לְהִנָּתֵן‎ Est 3:14; 8:13; —

1 be given to (usually with ל‎ person):

a. = bestowed upon Josh 24:33 (E), Ezek 11:15 (+ לְמוֺרָשָׁה‎), 33:24 (+ id.), Job 15:19; Ezek 16:34; Num 26:62 (P), Isa 9:5, portion from sacrifice Lev 10:14 (P), glory Isa 35:2, birthright 1Chr 5:1, freedom Lev 19:20 (H).

b. given to one (ל‎) for wife (ל‎) Gen 38:14 (J), 1Sam 18:19.

c. provided, usually with ל‎ Exod 5:16, 18 (J); 1Sam 25:27; 2Kin 25:30 = Jer 52:34; Isa 33:16; Neh 13:10; ׳נ אֶחָד מֵרֹעֶה‎ Eccl 12:11 they are given from one shepherd (i.e. words of wise) according to Ew De Hi-Now RüetschiKau; Wild understands subject of compilers.

d. = entrusted to Jer 13:20 compare 2Chr 2:13; with עַליָֿדָם‎ 2Kin 22:7, בְּיַד‎2Chr 34:16.

e. = give into the power of (usually with בְּיַד‎), especially of city (kg., people) given into the hand of foe 2Kin 18:30 (+ אֶתֿ‎ accusative), 19:10 = Isa 36:15; 37:10; Jer 21:10 18t. Jeremiah, Leviticus, Chronicles, Daniel; earth into hand of wicked Job 9:24; in good sense Gen 9:2 (P); delivered to death (ל‎), unto lower world (אֶלֿ‎), Ezek 31:14; given to us (ל‎) for devouring (ל‎) 35:12; נ ׳חֶרֶב‎ 32:20 delivered to the sword (strike out ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Co SgfrKau Toy); absolute, of צָבָא‎, Dan 8:12 (al. was appointed, see especially Dr), 11:6.

f. of request, be granted to (ל‎), Est 2:13; 5:3 (בַּקָּשָׁה‎), 5:6; 7:2; 9:12 (all שְׁאֵלָה‎), compare 7:3 (בְּבַקָּשָׁה בִּשְׁאֵלָה,‎).

g. = be permitted Est 9:13 (+ infinitive).

h. = be issued, published (of royal decree), absolute Est 3:5, 14; 4:8; 8:13-14, 9:14; of law given משֶׁה בְּיַד‎ Neh 10:30.

i. = be uttered, ׳נ קוֺלָם שְׁאוֺן‎ Jer 51:55 (of stormers of Babylon).

j. be assigned for (ל‎), Ezek 47:11.

2 Be put, set:

a. literally, crown בְּראֹשׁ‎ Est 6:8; of personified folly ׳נ מִים בַּמְּרוֺ הַסֶּכֶל‎ Eccl 10:6.

b. in imagery of Ezek. ׳נ בְּיַרְכְּתֵיבֿוֺר ֗֗֗‎ Ezek 32:23, with אֵת‎ (with) 32:29, with בְּתוֺךְ‎ 32:25, vine put (cast) לְאָכְלָה לָאֵשׁ‎ 15:4 into the fire for consuming; figurative of terror ׳נ בארץ‎ 32:25.

c. = be made, יִנָּתֵן חָצִיר בֶּןאָֿדָם‎ Isa 51:12.

d. = be inflicted, of blemish (מוּם‎) Lev 24:20 (with בְּ‎ person).

Hoph`al (or

Qal passive Ges§ 53a) Imperfect יֻתַּן‎ 1Kin 2:21+ 5 t. + 2Sam 21:6 Qr (Kt ינתן‎); וַיֻּתַּן‎ 18:9; —

1. a. be given, bestowed, absolute Num 26:54; with לְ‎ person 2Kin 5:17; Num 32:5 (אֶתֿ‎ with accusative; both P); in exchange for (תַּ֫חַת‎) Job 28:15.

b. = be given to one (ל‎) for wife (ל‎) 1Kin 2:21 (Abishag, אֶתֿ‎ with accusative).

c. = be given, delivered, up to (ל‎) 2Sam 21:6.

2 be put upon (עַלֿ‎) Lev 11:38 (P); of Absalom וגו הַשָּׁמַיִם בֵּין ׳וַיֻּתַּן‎ 2Sam 18:9, < וַיִּתָּל‎ (√ תלה‎) ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ We Dr (?), Klo Kit Bu HPS.

[נְתַן‎] verb give (see Biblical Hebrew; ᵑ7‎ rare; Old Aramaic נתן‎, Imperfect ינתן‎, so Nabataean; Zinjirli, Palmyrene יתן‎; Egyptian Aramaic Imperfect ינתן אנתן,‎, etc., S-CPap. A 7 +, plural suffix תנתנונה‎ ib.J 9, Infinitive למנתן‎ S-CC 6, 9+); —

Pe`al Imperfect3masculine singular יִנְתִּןֿ‎ (K§ 42) Dan 2:16, suffix יִתְּנִנַּהּ‎ 4:15 +; 2 masculine singular תִּנְתֵּן‎ Ezra 7:20; 3masculine plural יִנְתְּנוּן‎ 4:13; Infinitive לְמִנְתַּ֑ן‎ 7:20; —

2 of man, give, allow, accusative time, Dan 2:16.

3 give, pay, accusative of thing, Ezra 4:13; 7:20 (+ מִן‎ of source), absolute 7:20.

עטרות.def:
H5852. Ataroth

עֲטָרוֺת‎ and (Num 32:34) עֲטָרֹת‎ proper name, of a location Αταρωθ, etc.:

1 East of Jordan (MI10, 11); —

a. Num 32:3 (+ דִּיבוֺן‎, etc.) — modern A‰‰arûs, approximately 8 miles north-northwest from Dibon — built by Gad 32:34 (+ עֲרֹעֵר ׳ד,‎, and also)

c. יוֺאָב בֵּית עַטְרוֺת‎ 1Chr 2:54 in Judah; a 'son' of Salma (+ Bethlehem, al.).

3 fig of honour, etc., Job 19:9 (|| כְּבוֺדִי‎ Lam 5:16; ע חַיִל ׳אַשֶׁת בַּעְלָהּ‎ Prov 12:4, compare 14:24; 17:6; ׳ע תִּפְאֶרֶת‎ 16:31 (of שֵׂיבָה‎); gift of wisdom 4:9; figurative of Jerusalem Isa 62:3 (|| מְלוּכָה צְנִיף‎, compare ׳ע גֵאוּת‎ 28:1, 3figurative of Samaria; figurative of ׳ע צְבִי ׳י,‎ 28:5 (|| תִּפְאָרָה צְפִירַת‎).

עיט.def:
H6213. asah

I. עָשָׂה‎2622 verb do, make (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; MI23, 26 עשתי‎, l.3; l.9 ואעש‎, l.24 Imperative עשו‎; Old Hebrew proper name מעשיהו אלעשה, עשיו,‎; not Aramaic, and not certainly found in South Semitic languages; on Sabean see especially DHMSB Berl. Akkadian 1886, 849); —

Qal2524 Perfect3masculine singular Gen 3:1 +, suffix עָשָׂהוּ‎ Hosea 8:6 +; 3 feminine singular עָֽשְׂתָה‎ Deut 22:21 +, וְעָשָׂת‎ consecutive Lev 25:21; 2masculine singular עָשִׂיתָ‎ Gen 3:14 +, etc.; Imperfect3masculine singular יַעֲשֶׂה‎ 18:25 +, וַיַּעֲשֶׂה‎ 1Kin 16:25 3t., וַיַּעַשׂ‎ Isa 5:2 +; יַעֲשֵׂה‎ 64:3, 2masculine singular תַּעֲשֶׂה‎ 1Sam 10:8, תַּעֲשֵׂה‎ Gen 26:29; Josh 7:9, jussive (with אַל‎) תַּעַשׂ‎ Gen 22:12 +, תַּעֲשֵׂה‎ 2Sam 13:12; Jer 40:16 Qr (Kt תַּעַשׂ‎); 1 singular אֶעֱשֶׂה‎ Gen 2:18 +, וָאֶעֱשֶׂה‎ Ezek 20:14; Dan 8:27, וָאַעַשׂ‎ Deut 10:3-4t. Ezekiel; etc.; Imperative masculine singular עֲשֵׂה‎ Judg 10:15 +; feminine singular עֲשִׂי‎ Jer 6:26 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute עָשׂה‎ 44:17 +; עָשׂוֺ‎ 7:5 2t. (4:18 van d. H. עָשׂוּ‎); construct עֲשׂוֺת‎ Gen 2:4 +, עֲשׂה‎ 50:20 2t., עֲשׂוֺ‎ 31:28, suffix עֲשׂתוֺ‎ 41:32 +, עֲשׂהוּ‎ Exod 18:18, etc.; Participle active עשֶֹׁה‎ Isa 5:5 +, suffix הָעשֹׁוֺ‎ Job 40:19 (but see below); plural עשִֹׁים‎ Gen 24:49 +; suffix עשָֹׁ֑י‎ Job 35:10 (yet see Ges§ 124k), etc.; passive עָשׂוּי‎ Exod 3:16 +, הֶעָשׂוּ‎ Job 41:25 (Ges§ 75k); feminine עֲשׂוּיָה‎ Ezek 21:20 +, etc.; —

I. 1. do (1560 + t.):

a. (1) with accusative active Gen 3:14 (J) 20:10 (E) + often; do right in eyes of ׳י‎ 2Kin 12:3; 14:13 +, evil 8:18, 27 + (compare I. עַיִן‎

3c); do God's commands, statutes, etc., Deut 16:12; 30:8; Num 15:39 (P); ׳ע חַיִל‎ 1Sam 14:48 + do might, i.e. mightily, valiantly; Proverbs 31:39 do efficiency, i.e. efficiently; = commit (offence) Lev 20:13 (H), Deut 20:18; followed by מִן‎ particle, מֵהֵנָּה מֵאַחַת וְעָשָׂה‎ Lev 4:2 and shall do a single one of them (things prohibited; see מִן‎ 3b (d)), compare י מִכָּלמִֿצְוֺת אַחַת ׳וְעָשׂוּ‎ 4:13; 4:22; 5:17 (all P); do = perform a work, with accusative of congnate meaning with verb מַעֲשֶׂה‎ Exod 18:20; 23:12 (E), also (׳י‎ subject) Deut 11:7; Dan 9:14; Eccl 3:11; with accusative מְלָאכָה‎ Gen 2:2 (twice in verse) (J), Exod 20:9-10, = Deut 9:13 (10 Words); with accusative דְּרָכֶיךָ‎ Isa 58:13; ׳ע עַל מְלוּכָה‎ 1Kin 21:7 = exercise sovereignty over; of ׳י‎ performing signs (אֹתֹת‎) Josh 24:17 (E), Num 14:11, 22 (JE), Deut 11:3, so Moses Exod 4:17 and (מֹפְתִים‎) 4:21. (2) do something to one (ל‎ person) Gen 20:9 (E), Judg 9:56 +; with עַל‎ reflexive Jer 26:19 do evil against ourselves; especially ׳י‎ subject, with לְ‎, do good to Exod 18:9 (E), 2 Kings 8:66, or evil Gen 42:28 (E); in phrase so may God do to me, etc. 1Sam 3:17; 2Kin 6:31 + (see יסף‎

Hiph`il 1.). (3) do something for one (ל‎ person) Gen 30:31; 1Kin 11:8 +, direct object omitted 1Sam 20:4; + ל‎ of thing Judg 21:7, 16 what shall we do for them, for wives ? with עַל‎ person Neh 5:19; with dativus ethicus [dative of interest] (ל‎) 1Sam 10:7; with לְ‎, of ׳י‎ doing kindness for 22:3; executing vengeance for Judg 11:36 (+ מִן‎ of enemy); ׳י‎ doing a sign (אוֺת‎) for 6:17 (elsewhere לְ אוֺת נָתַן‎), compare לְטוֺבָה אוֺת עֲשֵׂהעִֿמִּי‎ Psa 86:17. (4) do something (in relation or intercourse) wilth (אֵת‎ person), ׳י‎ subject Deut 1:30 all that he did with you, 10:21 (compare Psa 86:17 above), human subject 2Chr 24:24 (object שְׁפָטִים‎), Ruth 2:11. (5) seldom with ב‎, usually of executing judgment upon 1Sam 28:18; Isa 48:14, more Generally Est 1:15 what shall we do with the queen ? also, subject ׳י‎, Ezek 25:11; 28:26; Psa 149:7; 149:9; Num 33:4 (on false gods); in good sense, ׳ע בּ ׳חֲסָדִים‎ Neh 13:14. (6) of ׳י‎ doing the justice (מִשְׁמַּט‎) of any one, i.e. maintaining his cause 1Kin 8:45, 49; Psa 9:5. (7) with adverb do thus, כֹּה‎, Josh 6:14 (JE), according to, כְּ‎ Gen 6:22 (P), 18:21 (J), 1Kin 2:6; accusative as, כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ Gen 27:19 (J); Exod 1:17 (E) +; with בְּ‎ of manner, Judg 9:16a, Ezek 8:18; 25:15.

b. work for (ל‎ of thing) Gen 30:30 (J); with ל‎ person 1Sam 14:6; Ezek 29:20 (for ׳י‎); work in (ב‎) gold or other material 1Kin 7:14; 2Chr 2:6; 2:13; Exod 31:4-5, 35:32 (all P); with בָּהּ‎ (i.e. בָּעֲבֹדָה‎) 5:9 (J) in toil; work with (עִם‎) God 1Sam 14:45, so probably of God's working with (אֵת‎) Moses and Aaron 12:6 (usually appoint); with אֵת‎ with (of person in whose company, in whose field Ruth 2:19 (twice in verse) (gleaning); work כַּמֶּיהָ בְּחֵפֶץ‎ Prov 31:13; without preposition Exod 36:1; Neh 3:28.

2 deal with, with עִם‎, 2Chr 2:2; Dan 1:13 (כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ accusative as); with אֵת‎, Ezek 20:44; Psa 109:21; Ezek 22:14; Zeph 3:19 (perhaps; Gr Now insert כָּלָה‎, see

II 1 g), + כְּ‎ Jer 21:2, + בְּ‎ of manner Ezek 23:25, 29; with לְ‎ person + בְּ‎ 25:12; with בְּ‎ person, Jer 18:23; Dan 11:7, + כְּ‎ according to Neh 9:24; Est 3:11.

3 often in phrase, do kindness (חֶסֶד‎) with: with עִם (עִמָּדִ)‎ Gen 19:19; 24:12; 12:14 (J), Judg 1:24; 8:35; 1Sam 15:6; 2Sam 2:5; 10:2 = 1Chr 19:2 +; with עַל‎, 1Sam 20:8 (but read עִם‎ Vrss We Dr and others); absolute, Psa 109:16; object חֶסֶד‎ + אֱמֶת‎, with עִם‎, Josh 2:14 (JE) Judg 9:19; 2Sam 2:6; with אֵת‎ with, Gen 24:49; 32:11; 47:29 (all J); with לְ‎, Exod 20:6 = Deut 5:10; 2Sam 22:51 = Psalm 18:51; so ׳ע טוֺב‎, with עִם‎, Gen 26:29 (J), compare Judg 8:35; 9:16; with אֵת‎ with, 1Sam 24:19; 2Sam 2:6.

4 absolute act, act with effect, especially of ׳י‎, 1Kin 8:32, 39; Jer 14:7; Ezek 20:9, 14, 22; Psalm 22:32; Psa 37:5; Psalm 52:11; Dan 9:19; of men 2Chr 31:21; Dan 8:12, 24; 11:28, 30, 32; with ל‎ of person Ezek 31:11.

II. 1. make (670 + t.):

a. with object concrete, ark Gen 8:6, altar 13:4, idols Judg 18:24, 31 +, etc.

b. often of God's making (creating) Gen 3:1 (J), 1:7, 16, 25 (P), Neh 9:6; Job 9:9; Prov 8:26; 2Chr 2:11; Psa 95:5 +; making man 100:3; 119:73 (made by God's hands), in the womb Job 31:15 (twice in verse); making, constituting, nation Deut 26:19; 32:6, 15; participle suffix עשֵֹׁהוּ‎ his Maker Isa 17:7; Prov 14:31; 17:5 (הָעשֹׁוֺ‎ Job 40:19 is improbable, most read הֶעָשָׂוּי‎, with various interpretation of following words); עשֶֹׁךָ‎ Isa 51:13, עשֵֹׁנִי‎ Job 32:23 (Ginsb; Job 32:22 van d. H. Baer), עשֵֹׁנוּ‎ Psa 95:6; so apparently plural participle עשָֹׁ֑י‎ Job 35:10, עשַֹׁיִךְ‎ Isa 54:5 (Ges§ 124k explanation as sg.).

c. make something, with לְ‎ reflexive, make for thee Exod 20:4; Deut 9:12; 10:1 +, for (ל‎) another 1Sam 2:19; 2Sam 7:11; 1Kin 2:24 +; object מִשְׁתֶּה‎ banquet Gen 40:20; Est 5:4, also (no ל‎) Gen 29:22 (E) Judg 14:10; Est 5:5, 12 and (figurative, ׳י‎ subject) Isa 25:6; with ל‎ of thing, Deut 22:8; with ל‎ of animal Gen 33:17 (J).

d. make a name (שֵׁם‎) for oneself (ל‎) 2Sam 7:9; 1Chr 17:8, also (no ל‎) 2Sam 8:13; a new heart for oneself (ל‎) Ezek 18:31.

e. make war with (אֶת‎) Gen 14:2; Josh 11:18 (D); with עִם‎, Deut 20:12, 20; 1Chr 5:10, 19; absolute 22:8; with ל‎ reflexive Prov 24:6; participle מִלְחָמָה עשֵֹׁה‎2Chr 11:1; 26:11, 13; make peace, with ל‎ person Josh 9:15 (J); ׳ע בְרָכָה אִתִּי‎ 2Kin 18:31 make an agreement with me.

f. with ׳ע בּ ׳מֶּרֶץ ב,‎ Judg 21:15 ׳י‎ brought a catastrophe upon (compare פרץ‎).

g. with 2 accusative, make something out of (accusative mater.) Exod 25:18; 28:13; 37:17, 24; Song 3:10; Deut 10:3 +; make something into something (Ges§ 117ii) Hosea 8:4; Gen 27:9; Judg 17:4; Num 11:8; 17:3; Psa 104:4; make something כָּלָה‎, i. e. utterly destroy it Nahum 1:8; Zeph 1:18; Ezek 20:17; Neh 9:31; c. passive participle as 2nd accusative Exod 38:7 they made it לֻחֹת נְבוּב‎ hollow with boards, 39:9; but also with accusative + לְ‎, Hosea 2:10 gold they made into (ל‎) the Baal, Judg 8:27; Exod 27:3 (P), Deut 9:14; Jer 37:15; Ezek 4:9; Isa 44:17, 19; make something for (ל‎ person), + מִן‎ of material Song 3:9.

2 produce, yield: of grain, yielding meal Hosea 8:7 (twice in verse), vineyard, grapes Isa 5:2 (twice in verse); 5:4 (twice in verse); 5:10, tree, fruit 2Kin 19:30 = Isa 37:31; Hosea 9:16; Jer 12:2; 17:8; Ezek 17:23 (all figurative), Gen 1:11-12, (P); branches Job 14:9 and (figurative) Ezek 17:8; land, fruit Lev 25:21 compare Hab 3:17, absolute Gen 41:47; of seed Isa 5:10, vine, shoots Ezek 17:6 (figurative); of cows, yielding milk Isa 7:22; hippop. producing fat Job 15:27.

3 prepare, especially of dressing and cooking food, Gen 18:7-8, Judg 6:19; 13:5; 1Sam 25:18 (passive), 2Sam 12:4 (twice in verse); Gen 27:14, 17, 31; 2Sam 13:5, 7; 1Kin 17:12; Exod 12:39 (+ ל‎ reflexive); a bullock for sacrifice (see below) 1Kin 18:23, 25, 26; גוֺלָה כְּלֵי‎ Ezek 12:3 (+ ל‎ reflexive); a chamber Neh 13:7; prepare to build (+ ל‎ person and infinitive).

4 make offering, e.g. עוֺלָה‎ Judg 13:16; Jer 33:18; Lev 16:24, וָזֶבַח עוֺלָה‎ 2Kin 5:17 (+ ל‎ of deity), הַחַטָּאת‎ Lev 14:19, אִשֶּׁה‎ Num 15:3, 14, various offerings 1Kin 8:64; Lev 9:22; Ezek 45:17; 46:2 +; + ׳לי‎ to ׳י‎ Lev 17:9 +; also with accusative of thing sacrificed (perhaps originally prepare or provide, see above) Ezek 43:25 (twice in verse); 46:15; Lev 14:30; 15:15, 30; 16:9; Num 6:11, 17; Psa 66:15 (+ ל‎ of deity) +; absolute = offer sacrifice Exod 10:25 (E + ׳לי‎), to (ל‎) heathen gods 2Kin 17:32.

5 attend to, put in order: pare (the nails) Deut 21:12; wash (feet) 2Sam 19:25; trim (beard) v.19:25 (compare French faire la barbe, German die Haare machen).

6 observe, celebrate, religious festival, e.g. passover Exod 12:48; Num 9:4, 6, 13; Josh 5:10, also (+ ׳לי‎) Exod 12:48; Num 9:10, 14 (all P), Deut 16:1 +; sabbath Exod 31:16; Deut 5:15; feast of weeks 16:10, booths 16:13, Purim Est 9:21, 27, etc.

7 acquire property of various kinds (compare 'make money') Gen 12:5; 31:5 (J), Isa 15:7; Jer 17:11; 48:36; Deut 8:18; Ezek 22:18; 28:4 (twice in verse); 38:12; 2Chr 32:29; Eccl 2:8; + ל‎ reflexive Deut 8:17; 2Sam 15:1; 1Kin 1:5; of fruits from vineyards, etc. Psa 107:37.

8 appoint priests 1Kin 12:31; 13:33; 2Chr 2:17 (all + מִן‎ source), a feast 1Kin 12:32-33, (+ ל‎ person); ordain a sacrifice Num 28:6, a festal day Psa 118:24; institute, וְיִדְּעֹנִי אוֺב‎ ghost and familiar spirit 2Kin 21:6 2Chr 33:6 (compare DrDeut 18:11).

9 bring about, of ׳י‎s effecting a deliverance Exod 14:13 (לָכֶם‎), 1Sam 11:13; 2Sam 23:10 (insert also || 1Chr 11:13 Dr), 11:12; cause, followed by clause with שֶׁ‎ Eccl 3:14.

10 use, ׳וְע לִמְלַאכְתּוֺ‎ 1Sam 8:16; passive Exod 38:24.

11 spend, pass, days of life Eccl 6:12.

Niph`al97 Perfect3masculine singular נַעֲשָׂה‎ Judg 16:11 +; 3 feminine singular נֶעֶשְׂתָה‎ 2Sam 17:23 +, etc.; Imperfect3masculine singular יֵעָשֶׂה‎ Gen 29:26 +, 3 feminine singular with ו‎ subordinate וְתֵעָשׂ‎ Est 5:6; 7:2; 9:12 (Ges§ 109 f.), etc.; Infinitive construct הֵעָשׂוֺת‎ 9:1, 14, etc., Participle נַעֲשֶׂה‎ Neh 5:18, etc.; —

1 be done (passive of Qal I 1):

a. subject מְלָאכָה‎ Judg 16:11 (with ב‎ instrumental), Neh 6:16 (with אֱלֹהִים מֵאֵת‎ ), 6:9; Exod 12:16 4t.; subject omitted Ezek 44:14, indefinite Est 4:1; with כֵּן‎ 9:14; be done, כַּתּוֺרָה‎ Ezra 10:3; be committed, of offence, Deut 13:15; Num 15:24; Eccl 4:1 3t.; with negative not (yet) done, i.e. future Isa 46:10; be accomplished, performed, fulfilled Ezekiel 12:35; Ezekiel 12:38; Dan 11:36; Est 5:5; 7:2; 9:12; be executed, carried out, of sentence Eccl 8:11, decree Est 9:1; be followed, of counsel 2Sam 17:28; nearly = occur Eccl 1:9 (twice in verse); 1:13; 9:3, 6, subject מַעֲשֶׂה‎ 1:14; 2:17; 4:3; 8:9, 17, subject הֶבֶל‎ 8:14, עִנְיָן‎ 8:15.

b. Imperfect with negative, is (are) not done, not according to usage, of flagrant offences Gen 20:9 (E), 29:26 (with כֵּן‎), 34:7 (both J), 2Sam 13:12 (כֵּן‎); hence (P) not to be done, forbidden by ׳י‎ Lev 4:2, 13, 22, 27; 5:17.

c. be done to, with ל‎ of animal 1Sam 11:7 (כֹּה‎); ל‎ person Exod 2:4 (E) 21:31 (E; כַּמִּשְׁמָּט‎), Isa 3:11; Jer 5:13 (כֹּה‎), Lev 24:19 (H; כֵּן‎), Num 15:34 (P) + 8 t.; be done for, ל‎ person Judg 11:37; Est 6:3, עִם‎ person 6:3; ל‎ of thing Num 15:11 (כָּכָה‎).

d. be done upon, against (ב‎) Dan 9:12.

2 (passive of Qal II):

a. be made, of conr. things 1Kin 10:20 2Chr 9:19 (throne), Jer 3:16 (ark), 2Kin 12:14; Ezek 43:18; Exod 25:31; Num 4:36 (P); with accusative mat; Lev 2:7.

b. be produced from (מִן‎) vine Num 6:4.

c. be prepared, of food Exod 12:16; Lev 6:14; 7:9 (all P), Neh 5:18 (twice in verse).

d. be offered, מִנְחָה‎ Lev 2:8, 11, kid Num 28:15, 24.

e. be observed, passover 2 Kings 24:22; 2 Kings 24:23 (ל‎ of deity) = 2Chr 35:18-19, Purim Est 9:28.

f. be used + ל‎ of thing Lev 7:24 (P); 13:51 (P) Ezek 15:5 (twice in verse).

H5867. Eylam

I. עֵילָם‎ proper name, of a people et. terr. Elam, Αιλαμ, Ἐλαμεῖραι, well-known country and people northeast of Lower Tigris (Assyrian Elamtu DlPa 320 ff. COTGen 10:22); — as early invaders of Palestine 14:1, 9, allies of Assyr. Isa 22:6; foe of Babylon 21:2; abode of dispersed Israelites 11:11; prophesied against Jer 49:34-35, 36 (twice in verse) (Qr, Kt עולם‎), 49:37; 49:38; 49:39; Ezek 32:24, compare ע ׳כָּלמַֿלְכֵי‎ Jer 25:25; called 'son' of Shem Gen 10:22 (P) = 1Chr 1:17; purely local designation ׳ע הַמְּדִינָה‎ Dan 8:2.

II. עֵילָם‎ proper name, masculine Ηλαμ, Αιλαμ:

1 heads of families of returned exiles:

a. Ezra 2:7 = Neh 7:12.

b. Ezra 2:31 = Neh 7:34.

c. Ezra 8:7; 10:2 (Qr; Kt עולם‎), 10:26.

2. a chief of people Neh 10:15.

3 name in Benjamin 1Chr 8:24.

4 Levite name 1Chr 26:3.

5 a priest Neh 12:42.

Min, 1894): — 1. with verbs expressing (or implying) separation or removal, whether from a person or place, or in any direction, also from guilt, calamity, etc.: — thus

a. to descend from a mountain Exod 19:14, to fall from a roof Deut 22:8, from heaven Isa 14:12, to go up from a valley Josh 10:7, to raise up from the dunghill 1Sam 2:8, or the ground 2Sam 12:17. e. of the immediate, or efficient, cause (chiefly in poetry), in consequence of, at by (compare Greek ἀπό, as Hd. 2:54 ζήησιν ἀπὸ σφέων γενέσθαι): (a) the cause, a person Gen 19:36 + מן הָֽרְתָה‎ to be pregnant by, 49:25; 1Sam 31:3 מֵהַמּוֺרִים וַיָּחֶל‎ was in anguish from the archers, Hosea 7:4 מֵאֹפֶה בֹּעֵ֫רָה‎ (ni הֵם בֹּעֵר‎ leg.: see We), Psa 18:9; Nahum 1:5 ממנו רעשׁו הרים‎, Dan 11:31 (accents); with passive verb, Nahum 1:6 ממנו נִתְּצוּ הצורים‎, Psa 37:23 (compare Prov 20:24

d), Job 24:1; Eccl 12:11; Dan 8:11. (b) the cause, a thing, Gen 49:24 his arms were agile יעקב אביר מידי‎ from the hands, etc., Isa 6:4 the thresholds shook הַקּוֺרֵא מִקּוֺל‎ (so מקול‎ elsewhere, as 30:31; 33:3; Jer 8:16), 28:7 מִןהַֿשֵּׁכָר תָעוּ‎ (|| ב‎), 31:4, 9; 10:10; Ezek 19:10 became fruitful רַבִּים מִמַּיִם‎, 31:5; Job 4:9 יאֹבֵדוּ אֱלוֺהַּ מִנִּשְׁמַת‎ at the breath of God, 14:9 יַפְרִחַ מַיִם מֵרֵיחַ‎, 31:23; 39:26 יַאֲבֶרנֵֿץ הֲמִבִּינָָֽתְךָ‎ Psa 39:11; 73:19 מִןבַּֿלָּהוֺת תַּמּוּ סָפוּ‎, 78:65 מִיַּיִן מִתְרוֺנֵן‎, 104:15 משׁמן פנים להצהיל‎ from oil, 107:39, compare Job 7:14 (|| ב‎); so with י ׳מִגַּעֲרַת‎ at J.'s rebuke, 18:16; Job 76:7 +; with a passive verb, Gen 9:11 to be cut off הַמַּבּוּל מִמֵּי‎, 2Sam 7:29 יְבֹרַח וּמִכִּכָֽתְךָ‎, Isa 28:7 מןהֿיין נבלעו‎ are undone through wine (22:3 is dubious: see 1b), Obadiah 9; Job 28:4 רָ֑גֶל מִנִּי הַנִּשְׁכָּחִים‎; compare Isa 34:3; Hosea 6:8. (c) with verbs of fearing, to express the source of the emotion, as ירא‎ Psa 3:7 + often (also with מִמְּנֵי‎), מָּחַד‎ 27:1, נִבְהַל‎ Ezek 26:18, גּוּר‎ Deut 18:22; Job 41:17; Est 5:9 ממנו זָע ולא ולאקֿם‎; with בּוֺשׁ‎ to be disconcerted or disappointed, to express the source of the disappointment, Isa 1:29 + often; with שָׂמֵחַ‎ Prov 5:18; Eccl 2:10. feminine of the remoter cause, the ultimate ground on account of which something happens or is done. (N.B. The line between

e and

f. is not always clearly defined): Exod 2:23 they sighed מןהֿעבדה‎ on account of the bondage, 6:9; 15:23; Deut 7:7 not מֵרֻבְּכֶם‎ through, by reason of, your numbers did J. set his love upon you, Josh 22:24 to do a thing מִדְּאָנָה‎ out of carefulness, 2Sam 23:4 מִנֹּגַהּ‎, 1Kin 14:4; Isa 53:5 wounded מִמְּשָׁעֵינוּ‎ on account of our transgressions, bruised מֵעֲוֺנוֺתֵינוּ‎, 53:8; Job 4:19; Obadiah 10; Hab 2:17; Psa 6:8 מִכַּעַס עיני עשׁשׁה‎ from vexation (compare Job 17:7: Psa 31:10 ׳ב‎), 31:12; 38:19 I am concerned on account of my sin, Prov 20:4 יחרשׁ לא עצל מֵחֹרֶף‎ by reason of the winter, Job 22:4 יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ הֲמִיִּרְאָ֑תְךָ‎ on account of thy fear of him? Song 3:8; Ruth 1:13 מִכֶּם מְאֹד כִּימַֿרלִֿי‎ because of you: see also Deut 28:34, 67; 32:19; Judg 2:18; Isa 65:14; Jer 12:4; 24:2 מֵרֹעַ‎, 50:13; 51:5 b (Ew Ke), Ezek 7:27 (but read probably with ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Co כְּדרכם‎), 16:61; 35:11 (AV out of), 45:20; Micah 2:12; 7:13; Psa 5:11; 12:6; 107:17; 119:53; Gen 49:12 red of eyes מִיָּ֑יִן‎, and white of teeth מֵחָלָב‎. Often also in מֵרֹב‎ from the abundance of, absolute for abundance, with many different verbs, as 16:10 מֵרֹב יִסָּפֵר לֹא‎ Josh 9:13; 1Sam 1:16, etc. Similarly in מִבִּלְתִּי מִבְּלִי, מֵאֵין,‎ (pp. 35, 115, 117); and before an infinitive (7a), and in מֵאֲשֶׁר‎ (p. 84).

g. the cause being conceived as regulative, מן‎ occasionally approaches in sense to according to (compare Latin ex more, ex lege), Jonah 3:7 proclaimed in Nineveh וגדליו המלך מטעם‎ at, by, in accordance with, the decree of the king (compare Aramaic Ezra 6:14; Dan 2:8): so Job 39:26 (2e (b)) according to Ges Hi.

3 Partitively (a sense connecting with

2a (c), above): —

a. Gen 6:19 מִכֹּל שְׁנַיִם‎ two out of, from, all, 7:8; 39:11 ֗֗֗ מן אישׁ‎ a man (or one) of . . . (so Num 25:6; 1 Samuel 24:28 +, ֗֗֗ מן אנשׁים‎ 16:2; Josh 2:2 +, 2Kin 2:7, etc.); Gen 42:16 send אֶחָד מִכֶּם‎ Lev 1:2a 17:12 מִכֶּם כלנֿפשׁ‎, 19:34; 26:8, Judg 8:14 סֻכּוֺת מֵאַנְשֵׁי נַעַר‎, 1Sam 22:8, etc.; Judg 14:19; 2Kin 2:24; Isa 66:19; ֗֗֗ מִן אֶחָד‎ 1Sam 16:18 +, ֗֗֗ מִן אַחַד‎ (Ges§ 130, 1) Deut 25:5 +; מֵהֵ֫נָּה אַחַת‎ Psa 34:21; Isa 34:16; ֗֗֗ מִן מִי‎ Job 5:1; Isa 50:1, ֗֗֗ מִן אֵין‎ 1Sam 14:39; Isa 51:18; 21:11 מלילה מהֿ‎ how much of the night? 2Chr 31:3 מִןרְֿכוּשׁוֺ הַמֶּלָח וּמְנָת‎.

b. the number being omitted, מִן‎ is used indefinitely: — (a) = some of, — as subject Exod 16:27 מןהֿעם יצאו‎ there went out (some) of the people, Lev 25:49; 2Sam 11:17, 24, especially in late Hebrew Ezra 2:68, 70; 7:7; Neh 11:4, 25; 1Chr 4:42; 9:30, 32; 2Chr 17:11; 32:21; Dan 11:35; more frequently as object, especially with לקח‎, Gen 4:3 האדמה מִמְּרִי וַיָּבֵא‎ brought of the fruit of the ground, 30:14 give me בְנֵךְ מִדּוּדָאֵי‎ (some) of thy son's love-apples, 33:15; Exod 12:7; 17:5; Lev 18:30; 20:2; Num 11:17; 13:23; 1Kin 12:4; Isa 39:7; 47:13; Amos 2:11; Dan 8:10 +, Song 1:2 מִּיו מִנְּשִׁיקוֺת ישׁקני‎ let him kiss me (with) some of the kisses etc., Psa 72:15; 137:3 צִיּוֺן מִשִּׁיר‎ (some) of the songs of Zion, Job 11:6 (Ges RVm) + often; in late Hebrew note also ֗֗֗ מִן יֵשׁ‎ there are some of . . . Neh 5:5; ֗֗֗ מֵהֶם ֗֗֗ מֵהֶם‎ some. . . others. . . 1Chr 9:28f. (as in Aramaic Dan 2:33, and PS2155); ֗֗֗ מִקְצָת‎ some of. . . (as in Late Hebrew) 1:2; Neh 7:69. (b) to designate an individual (rare), Gen 28:11 and he took הַמָּקוֺם מֵאַבְנֵי‎ (one) of the stones of the place (see 28:18), Exod 6:25 פוטיאל מבּנות‎ (one) of the daughters of P., Ezek 17:5, 13; Neh 13:28; Psa 132:11; as subject Lev 25:33; Dan 11:5 the king of the south וּמִןֿ שָׂרָיו‎ and (one) of his captains, 11:7, compare Jer 41:1; Est 4:5; 2Chr 26:11; Ruth 2:20 הוא מִגֹּאֲלֵנוּ‎ he is (one) of our kinsmen, Exod 2:6. (c) in a negative or hypothetical sentence (whether subject or object) = any, aught, Deut 16:4 מןהֿבשׂר ילין ולא‎ and there shall not remain any of the flesh, 1Kin 18:5 מןהֿבהמה נכרית ולא‎ and we shall not destroy any of the beasts, 2Kin 10:10 (compare Josh 21:43; 23:14; 1Sam 3:19; 1Kin 8:56; Est 6:10), Esther 6:23 י מֵעַבְדֵי ׳מֶּןיֶֿשׁמֹּֿה‎ Job 27:6 מִיָּמָ֑י לְבָבִי יֶחֱרַף לֹא‎ my heart reproacheth not one of my days: with אִם‎, etc. Exod 29:34; Lev 4:2a (compare 4:22; 4:27), 11:32 (מהם‎), 11:33; 11:35; 11:37-39; 18:29; 25:25; Num 5:6; מִכֹּל‎ anything whatever, Leviticus 5:24; Lev 11:34; compare 1Sam 23:23 (?). (d) peculiarly, with a noun of unity, especially אֶחָד‎, to express forcibly the idea of a single one: Deut 15:7 if there be a poor man in thy midst, אַחֶיךָ מֵאַחַר‎ any one of thy brethren, Lev 4:2b if he doeth מֵהֵ֫נָּה מֵאַחַת‎ any one of these things, 5:13; Ezek 18:10 אָח וְעָשָׂה מֵאֵלֶּה מֵאַחַד‎ (where אח‎ is a vox nihili) and doeth aught of these things; 1Sam 14:45 if there shall fall אַרְצָה ראֹשׁוֺ מִשַּׂעֲרַת‎ a single hair of his head to the ground! (for שְׂעָרָה‎ as a noun of individual meaning see Ges§ 122t Dr), compare 2Sam 14:11; 1Kin 1:52. (Probably a rhetorical application of the partitive sense, though the explanation 'starting from one' = 'even one' would also be possible. is used similarly after negative and interrogative particles, not merely with collective nouns, as nought have they of knowledge (Qor 18:4), but also with nouns of unity, as Qor 3:55 Ye have not aught of (= any) god, except Him; 19:19 dost thou perceive even one of them? 6:59 there falleth not even a single leaf (noun of individual meaning) without His knowing it. See further Thes, and WAG. ii. § 48 f. b), (e) (rare) specifying the objects, or elements, of which a Genus consists (the Arabic , min of explication, WAG. ii. § 48 g): Gen 6:2 מכל בחרו אשׁר‎ consisting of all whom they chose, 7:22; 9:10; Lev 11:32 (מכל‎), 1Chr 5:18; Jer 40:7 (מאשׁר‎); 44:28 and they shall know וּמֵהֶם מִמֶּנִּי יָקוּם דְּבַרמִֿי‎ whose word shall stand, consisting of me and of them (defining the Genus embraced by ׃מי‎ compare both (of them), Abel as well as Cain, and Qor 3:193: Wl.c.). — On מֵאַיִן‎ 10:6-7, see אַיִן‎ near the end.

4 of time — namely

a. as marking the terminus a quo, the anterior limit of a continuous period, from, since Deut 9:24 אֶתְכֶם דַּעְתִּי מִיּוֺם‎ from the day of my (first) knowing you (so 1Sam 7:2; 8:8 + ); 18:9 וָהָֽלְאָה ההוא מהיום‎ from that day and onwards, simil. Lev 22:27; Num 15:23; Ezek 39:22; Isa 18:2, 7 (where מִןהֿוּא‎ = הוּא מֵאֲשֶׁר‎; compare Nahum 2:9 הִיא מִימֵי‎ = הִיא אֲשֶׁר מִימֵי‎); וָמָֽעְלָה ההוא מהיום‎ 1Sam 16:13; 30:25 (Hag 2:15, 18 apparently of time backwards); מֵאָז‎ from the time of . . . .; מִןהַֿבֶּטֶן‎ from the womb Judg 13:5, 7, אִמִּי מִבֶּטֶן‎ 16:17 +; ֗֗֗ מִימֵי‎ Hosea 10:9; Isa 23:7; Jer 36:2 +; מִיָּמֶיךָ‎ idiomatic = since thou wast born 1Sam 25:28; 1Kin 1:6 (מִיָּמָיו‎), Job 38:12; מִקֶּדֶם‎ from antiquity Hab 1:12; Psa 74:12; Isa 42:14 מֵעוֺלָם הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי‎ I have been silent since old time; מֵעַתָּה‎ from now, hence-forth Jer 3:4 +, מִיּוֺם‎ from to-day 43:13; Ezek 48:35, הזה מןהֿיום‎ Hag 2:19. See also 5c, 7 c. compare Exod 33:6 חוֺרֵב מֵהַר‎ from Horeb, Hosea 13:4 I am ׳י‎ thy God מִצְרַיִם מֵאֶרֶץ‎.

b. as marking the period immediately succeeding the limit, after: Gen 38:24 חֳדָשִׁים כְּמִשְׁלשׁ‎ after about three months it was told Judah, רַבִּים מִיָּמִים‎ Josh 23:1; Ezek 38:8, מִיָּמִים‎ after (some) days, Judg 11:4; 14:8; 15:1, מִיֹּמַיִם‎ after two days Hosea 6:2; יָמִים מֵרֹב‎ Isa 24:22: more frequently with קֵץ‎ or קָצֶה‎, Gen 4:3 יָמִים מִקֵּץ‎, 8:3; Josh 3:2 + often; Deut 14:28 שָׁנִים שָׁלשׁ מִקְצֵה‎, 15:1 שֶׁבַע מִקְצֵה שָׁנִים‎ (by which is meant not the actual end of the three or seven years, but the period when the third or seventh year has arrived); מִמָּחֳרָת‎ after the morrow (had arrived) = on the morrow, Gen 19:34 + often; מֵהַבֹּקֶר‎ 2Sam 2:27. — 23:4 מִמָּטָר‎; Isa 53:11 נַפְשׁוֺ מֵעֲמַל‎; perhaps 29:18 (Kö581). compare 2Sam 20:5 and he delayed מןהֿמועד‎ beyond the appointed time.

c. in such phrases, however, מִן‎ sometimes (compare 1c) loses its significance: thus מֵאָז‎ 2Sam 15:34; Isa 16:13 not from former time, but in former time, formerly, Gen 6:4 מֵעוֺלָם אֲשֶׁר הַגִּבּוֺרִים‎ which were of old, Josh 24:2 dwelt of old, Psa 77:6 days מִקֶּדֶם‎ aforetime, מֵאַחֲרֵי‎ Deut 29:21 (p. 30). — מִקָּרוֺב‎ literally from near, i.e. recently 32:17, of short duration Job 20:5, shortly Ezek 7:8; at hand (in a local sense, 1c) Jer 23:23.

5 (וְעַד‎) עַד ֗֗֗ מִן‎ from . . . even, to : very oft .: —

a. in geography or local sense, Gen 10:19; 15:18 הגדול הנהר עד מצרים מנהר‎, 25:18; Exod 23:31; Deut 2:36; 1Sam 3:20; 2Sam 5:25; Jer 31:38; Psa 72:8 + often; so with מִלְּבוֺא‎ 1Kin 8:65 (2Chr 7:8), 2Kin 14:25; Amos 6:14; Deut 13:8 הָאָרֶץ קְצֵה וְעַד הָאָרֶץ מִקְצֵה‎, 28:64; Jer 12:12; Gen 47:21 וְעַדקָֿצֵהוּ גְּבוּלמִֿצְרַיִם מִקְצֵה‎, 1Kin 6:24; 7:23 וְעַד מִשְּׂפָתוֺ שְׂפָתוֺ‎; Lev 13:12 רגליו ועד מראשׁו‎, Deut 28:35 רגלך מכף קדקדך ועד‎ (similarly 2Sam 14:25; Job 2:7; Isa 1:6). compare 1Sam 9:2 וָמַ֫עְלָה מִשִּׁכְמוֺ‎, 2Sam 5:9; Josh 15:46.

b. metaphor not of actual space, but of classes of objects, to express idiomatically the idea ofcomprehension, so that the two prepositions may be often represented by both . . . and: Gen 19:4 וְעַדזָֿקֵן מִנַּעַר‎ from young to old (i.e. both included) = both young and old, 19:11; 1Sam 5:9 + וְעַדגָּֿדוֺל מִקָּטֹן‎ = both great and small, Jer 6:13 וְעַדגְּֿדוֺלָם מִקְּטַנָּם‎ from the least of them even to the greatest of them, ib. מִנָּבִיא וְעַדכֹּֿהֵן‎ from the prophet even to the priest every one dealeth falsely, Exod 9:25 + בהמה ועד מאדם‎ both man and beast, 11:5 וגו השׁפחה ׳בכור פרעהע֗֗֗ד מבכור‎, 13:15; Num 6:4; Deut 29:10 עציך מחֹטב מימיך שֹׁאב עד‎, Josh 8:25 + אשׁה ועד מאישׁ‎, 1Sam 15:3 (4 pairs), 22:19; 1Kin 5:13; 2Kin 17:9 = 18:8, Isa 10:18 בשׂר ועד מנפשׁ‎ = both soul and body, Jer 9:9; after a word implying a negative = either . . . or Gen 14:23; 31:24, 29 רע עד מטוב‎ either good or evil. The עַד‎ may be repeated, if required: 6:7 מאדם השׁמים ועדעֿוף רמשׂ עד עדבֿהמה‎ (so 7:23), Exod 22:3; Josh 6:21; Judg 15:5 זָ֑יִת וְעַדכֶּֿרֶם וְעַדקָֿמָה מִגָּדִישׁ‎, 20:48; 1Sam 30:19: without מן‎, Lev 11:42; Num 8:4. Similar is the use of מן‎ in the idiom (וָמָֽטָּה‎) וָמָֽעְלָה מִבֶּןשָׁ֗֗֗נָה‎ (also שָׁנָה ֗֗֗ וְעַדבֶּֿן‎); and compare 2Kin 3:21

c. of time, Gen 46:34 עַתָּה וְעַד מִנְּעֻרֵינוּ‎ from our youth even until now, 1Sam 12:2; Jer 3:25; Num 14:19; Exod 10:6; 18:13 עדהֿערב מןהֿבֹקר‎, 1Sam 30:17; 1Kin 18:26; Isa 9:6; Psa 90:2; + often: with two inff. Hosea 7:4: and implying intervals (not duration) Ezek 4:10-11, (compare with לְ‎ Est 3:7 (twice in verse)).

d. there occur further (1) אֶלֿ ֗֗֗ מִן‎, Josh 15:21; Exod 26:28 = 36:33 אֶלהַֿקָּצֶה מִןהַֿקָּצֶה‎ from end to end, Ezek 40:23, 27; Ezra 9:11 מִמֶּהאֶֿלמֶּֿה‎; Psa 144:13 זַן אֶל מִזַּן‎ from kind to kind = kinds of every sort; with a verb of motion, Jer 48:11; Psa 105:13; 1Chr 17:5, and expressing a climax, Psa 84:8 אֶלחַֿיִל מֵחַיִל יֵָֽלְכוּ‎, Jer 9:2 (compare Rom 1:17): of time, מיוםאֿליֿום‎ Num 30:15, compare 1Chr 16:23 (|| Psa 96:2 לְ‎); implying intervals, אֶלעֵֿת מֵעֵת‎ 1Chr 9:25. (2) לְ ֗֗֗ מִן‎ Exod 32:27; Ezek 40:13; Zech 14:10: of time Psa 96:2; Job 4:20: with intervals, 2Sam 14:26. (3) הָ֯ ֗֗֗ מִן‎ Num 34:10; Ezek 6:14; רִבְלָ֫תָה מִמִּדְבָּר‎ (so Ges Ew Hi etc.) from the wilderness to Riblah, 21:3; 25:13 וּדְדָ֫נֶה מִתֵּימָן‎ (Co Kö Berthol); without ָ֯‎ 1Kin 5:1. And of time in the phrase (implying intervals) יָמִ֫ימָה מִיָּמִים‎ Exod 13:10 4t.

6 In comparisons, beyond, above, hence in English than: so constantly: namely

a. when an object is compared with another distinct from itself, Judg 14:18 מִדְּבַשׁ מַהמָּֿתוֺק‎ what is sweet away from, beyond in excess of, honey ? i.e. in our idiom, what is sweeter than honey ? Lev 21:10 מֵאֶחָיו הַגָּדוֺל הַכֹּהֵן‎ the priest that is great above his brethren, Num 14:12; Ezek 28:3 מִדָּנִאֵל חָכָם‎ wiser than Daniel, Psa 119:72 + very often; Hosea 2:9 מֵעָ֑תָּה אָז לִי טוֺב כִּי‎; with an infinitive (sometimes with לְ‎) as subject, Gen 29:10 וגו אֹתָהּ מִתִּתִּי לְךָ אֹתָהּ תִּתִּי ׳טוֺב‎ better is my giving her to thee than my giving her to another, Exod 14:12; 1Sam 15:22; Prov 21:9, 19; 25:7; Psa 118:8; 118:9 +; with verbs, Gen 19:9 מֵהֶם לְךָ נָרַע עתה‎ now we will harm thee beyond them, more than them, 25:23 יֶאֱמַץ מִלְאֹם לְאֹם‎, 26:16; 29:30 גםֿ ויאהב מִלֵּאָה אתרֿחל‎, 38:26 מִמֶּנִּי צָֽדְקָה‎, 48:19 מִמֶּנּוּ יִגְדַּל‎, Judg 2:19 מאבותם השׁחיתו‎ they have done corruptly more than their fathers, 1Sam 2:29; 2Sam 20:6; 1Kin 1:37; 14:9; Jer 5:3; Ezek 5:6 + often; = in, preference to, above, Psa 45:8; 52:5 (twice in verse); Hosea 6:6; Hab 2:16, after בחר‎ Jer 8:3; Job 7:15; 36:21; Psa 84:11 (מִדּוּר‎) +: note also מִן נֹפֵל‎ Job 12:3; 13:2 +?to (Ew Ges and others Hi; al. De); מִן שֹׁנֶה‎ different from Est 1:7; 3:8.

b. when an object is compared with a group or multitude of which it forms one, especially with מִכֹּל‎, Gen 3:1 עָרוּם הַשָּׂדֶה חַיַּת מִכֹּל‎ subtil out of all beasts of the field, or beyond, above all (other) beasts, 3:14 cursed above all cattle (but without implying any judgment whether other cattle are cursed likewise), 37:3 Israel loved Joseph מִכָּלבָּֿנָיו‎ out of all his sons, or above all his (other) sons, Deut 7:7; 33:24 אָשֵׁר מִבָּנִים בָּרוּךְ‎ blessed above sons be Asher, Judg 5:24 מִנָּשִׁים תְּבֹרַח‎ blessed above women be Jael, 1Sam 9:2b 15:33 אִמֶּ֑ךָ מִנָּשִׁים תִּשְׁכַּל כֵּן‎, 18:30; Jer 17:9 מִכֹּל עָקֹב‎ deceitful above all things, Psa 45:3; Song 5:10 מֵרְבָבָה דָּגוּל‎ (compare מִן בָּחַר‎ above

2a c: ex in eximius, egregius; Iliad 18:431 ὅς σ’, ἐμοὶ ἐκ πάσεων Κρονίδης Ζεὺς ἄλγἐ ἔδωκεν, 3:227 ἔξοχος Ἀργείων . . . κεφαλήν).

c. sometimes in poetry the idea on which מן‎ is logically dependent, is unexpressed, and must be understood by the reader, Isa 10:10 מירושׁלם ופסיליהם‎ and their idols are (more) than (those of) Jerusalem, Micah 7:4 מִמְּסוּכָה יָשָׁר‎ the uprightest is (sharper) than a thorn-hedge (but We from), Job 11:7; 28:18; Psa 4:8 מֵעֵת‎ beyond (that of) the time when etc. Ecclesiastes 4:17; Eccl 9:17; compare Ezek 15:2.

d. מן‎ not unfrequently expresses the idea of a thing being too much for a person, or surpassing his powers: Gen 18:14 ׳מי הֲיִמָּלֵא דָּבָר‎ can a thing be too hard for J.? (so Deut 17:8 +; compare Psa 131:1; 139:6 + ), 32:11 מִן קָטֹנְתִּי‎, Deut 14:24 הַדֶּרֶךְ מִמְּךָ יִרְבֶּה כִּי‎ = is too great for thee (1Kin 19:7), 1Ki 32:47 מִכֶּם רֵק‎: so with עָצַם‎ Gen 26:16, כָּבֵד‎ be too heavy for Exod 18:18; Psa 38:5, מָךְ‎ Lev 27:8 (too poor to pay), קָשָׁה‎ Deut 1:7, צַר‎ be too narrow for, 2Kin 6:1; Isa 49:19, קצר‎ 50:2, אָמַץ‎ Psa 18:18, נמני ירום‎ is too high for me 61:3, גָּבַר‎ 65:4; מִמְּךָ ַהמְעַט‎ Job 15:11 too little for thee ? מִכֶּם ַהמְעַט‎ Num 16:9; Isa 7:13; Ezek 34:18 (see מְעַט‎; also on 16:20); often with an infinitive, as Gen 4:13 מִנְּשׂוֺא עֲוֺנִי גָּדוֺל‎ is greater than I can bear, 30:7 their substance was יַחְדָּו מִשֶּׁבֶת רַב‎ literally great beyond dwelling together = too great for (their) dwelling together, Exod 12:4; Judg 7:2 רַב מִתִּתִּי‎ = too great for me to give, 1Sam 25:17b 1Kin 8:64 מֵהָכִיל רַב‎, Isa 28:20; 33:19; 59:1; Hab 1:13; Psa 40:6; Ruth 1:12: note especially מִן רַב‎ it is more than that . . . (= there is enough of), Exod 9:28; 1Kin 12:28, followed by substantive Ezek 44:6 (see רַב‎); and Isa 49:6 וגו לְהָקִים ׳עֶבֶד לִי מִהְיוֺתְךָ נָקֵל‎ too light for thy being my servant was it to raise up, etc., Ezek 8:17 וגו ׳מֵעֲשׂוֺת יִשְׂר לְבֵית ׳הֲנָקֵל‎ was it too trifling to the house of Israel for the doing etc. (less than the doing etc. deserved) ? (but ? read עֲשׂוֺת‎ on analogue of 1Kin 16:31).

7 מן‎ is prefixed to an infin.:

a. with a causal force (rare), from, on account of, through (compare 2f): Deut 7:7-8, י ׳מֵאַהֲבַת אֶתְכֶם‎ through J.'s loving you = because J. loved you, 9:28 (compare 1:27 בְּ‎) 2Sam 3:11 אֹתוֺ מִיִּרְאָתוֺ‎ = because he feared him, Isa 48:4 ֗֗֗ מִדַּעְתִּי‎ = because I knew. . . So in מִבִּלְתִּי , ֗֗֗ מִבְּלִי‎.

b. after verbs implying restraint, prevention, cessation, etc., as עֲצָרַנִי מִלֶּדֶת‎ Gen 16:2 hath restrained me from bearing, מִלֶּדֶת וַתַּעֲמֹד‎ 29:35; 30:9: so with חשׂך‎ 20:6 +, חדל‎ + Exod 23:5 +, כִּלָּה‎ + 34:33 +, נִכְלָא‎ 36:6, מָנַע‎ 1Sam 25:26 +, שׁבת‎ Jer 31:36 +, מֵהַבִּיט יָרֵא‎ Exod 3:6 +, מִןהַֿחֵרֶם שִׁמְרוּ‎ Josh 6:18; 2Chr 25:13 מִלֶּכֶת הֵשִׁיב‎. Especially (a) after similar verbs, expressing concisely a negative consequence, literally away from . . ., i.e. so as not to, so that not: Gen 23:6; b 27:1 Jacob's eyes were dim, ֵמרְאֹת‎ away from seeing = so that he could not see, 31:29 מִן נִשְׁמַר‎ (|| 31:24 מֶּן‎), Exod 14:5; Lev 26:13; Num 32:7; Deut 28:55 (his eye shall be envious etc.) מִתֵּת‎ from giving = so that he will not give, Judg 6:27; 1 Samuel 21:31; 1Sam 7:8 do not be silent from us מִזְּעֹק‎ so as not to call (compare 1Kin 22:3), 1Sam 8:7 me have they rejected עליהם מִמְּלֹךְ‎, 16:1 (Hosea 4:6), 2Sam 14:11 (read מֵהַרְבּוֺת‎), Isa 5:6; 8:11; 21:3; 23:1 is destroyed מִבּוֺא‎ so that none can enter in, 24:10; 33:15; 44:18; 49:15; 54:9; 56:6; 58:13; Jer 10:14 מִדַּעַת ֗֗֗ נִבְעַר‎ is stupefied so that he has no knowledge, 13:14; 33:21, 24, 26; Ezek 20:17; Micah 3:6; Zech 7:11; 7:12; Psa 30:4 Qr, 39:2; 69:24; 102:5 (after שָׁכַח‎, peculiarly), 106:23; Lam 3:44; 4:18; Job 34:30a 2Chr 36:13. So in מֵעֲשׂוֺת חָלִילָהלִֿי‎ that I should not do Gen 44:17 +. (b) still more concisely, especially in poetry, with a noun alone: 1Sam 15:23 has rejected thee מִמֶּלֶךְ‎ from (being) king (15:26 מִהְיוֺת מֶלֶךְ‎), Lev 26:43 מֵהֶם‎, Isa 7:8 מֵעָם יֵחַת‎ shall be shattered from (being) a people, that it be no more a people, 17:1 מֵעִיר מוּסָר‎, 25:2b; 52:14 מִשְׁחַת כֵּן מַרְאֵהוּ מֵאִישׁ‎ marred away from (being) a man('s), Jer 2:25 מִיָּחֵף‎, 17:16 מֵרֹעֶה‎, 48:2 מִגּוֺי וְנַכְרִיתֶנָּה‎, 48:42 מֵעָם‎, Psa 8:6 hast made him lack but little מאלהים‎ ut non esset Deus, 83:5 מִגּוֺי‎, Prov 30:2 בַּעַר מֵאִישׁ אָנֹכִי‎ too boorish to be a man: compare Dan 4:13; 1Kin 15:13 מִגְּבִירָה וַיְסִרֶהָ‎ removed her from (being) queen-mother, Ezek 16:41 מִזּוֺנָה וִהִשְׁבַּתִּיךְ‎; and even to express absolutely the non-existence of a thing not named in the principal clause, as Isa 23:1 כִּי מִבַּיִת שֻׁדַּד‎ so that there is no house, Ezek 12:19 (32:15), 25:9 מֵהֶעָרִים‎, Hosea 9:11 (3 t. in verse); 9:12; Micah 3:6; Hag 1:10 מִטָּ֑ל‎, Zech 7:14; 9:8; Psa 39:3; 49:15 מִזְּבֻללֿוֺ‎ so that it has no dwelling, 52:7 מֵאֹהֶל יִסָּֽחֲךָ‎ pluck thee up tentless, 109:24 is lean מִשָּׁ֑מֶן‎ so that there is no fatness, Job 28:11; 33:21; 34:30b. Oft. strengthened by pleonastic אֵין‎ or בְּלִי‎, as יוֺשֵׁב מֵאֵין‎ Isa 5:9, יוֺשֵׁב מִבְּלִי‎ see pp. 35:a, 115:b. compare Köiii. 592 ff.

c. with a temporal force, since, after (compare

4), chiefly late: Num 24:23 אֵל מִשֻּׂמוֺ‎ after God's establishing him, Isa 44:7 עֿוֺלָם עַם מִשֻּׂמִי‎ since I appointed the ancient people, Hosea 7:4; Hag 2:16 (?) Ruth 2:18; Neh 5:14; 1Chr 8:8 אוֺתָם מִןשִֿׁלְחוֺ‎ (compare 6:16) 2Chr 31:10; Dan 11:23; 12:1 (compare 9:25), Psa 73:20 מֵהָקִיץ כַּחֲלוֺם‎ after (one's) awaking, Job 20:4.

8 Once Deut 33:11 as a

conjunction before a finite verb. Smite . . . his haters מִןיְֿקוּמוּן‎ that they rise not again, in poetry for מִקּוּם‎ (7b): compare Dr§ 41. — On מֵאֲשֵׁר‎

adverb and

conjunction.

9 In compounds: —

a. מִלְּ מִבַּ֫עַד, מִבַּלְעֲדֵי, מִבֵּין, מֵאֵת, מֵאַחֲרֵי,‎ (common in Late Hebrew, **for מִלְּ‎ in Mishna see e.g. Babylonian Mez 7:10; Kil 8:1; Ter 8:11; Pes 1:6; Taan 2:7; Yeb 8:2; Ecclesiastes 4:17 מִלַּעֲשׂוֺת‎ (have no knowledge so as not to do evil) is read by Siegf Wild; especially before infinitive; in O.T. only in מִלְּבוֺא מִלְּבַד,‎ (above 5a), מִלִּפְנֵי מִלְּפָנִים, מִלְּעֻמַּת, מִלְמַ֫טָּה, מִלְמַ֫עְלָה,‎, and, si vera lectio, הֶחָ֑רֶס מִלְמַעֲלֵה‎ Judg 8:13, see מַעֲלֶה‎), מִתַּ֫חַת מֵעִם, מֵעַל, מִנֶּגֶד,‎; see אֵת אַחֲרֵי,‎, etc.

b. לְמִן‎ (לְמִנִּי‎ Micah 7:12 (twice in verse)), with לְ‎ pleonastic, from = מִן‎, but used almost exclusively of the terminus a quo, whether of space or time (compare מִן‎

5); — (I) of space, Deut 4:32; Judg 20:1 שֶׁבַע וְעַדבְּֿאֵר לְמִדַּן‎, Micah 7:12.7:12 (both לְמִנִּי‎), Zech 14:10; 1Chr 5:9; לְמֵרָחוֺק‎ from afar Job 36:3; 39:29 (on Ezra 3:13; 2Chr 26:15, see below לְ עַד‎); לְ לְמִתַּחַת‎ = underneath 1Kin 7:32. Idiomatic, especially followed by וְעַד‎, to denote comprehensively an entire class, בְּהֵמָה וְעַד לְמֵאִישׁ‎ Exod 11:7; Jer 51:62 (לְמֵאָדָם‎), אִשָּׁה וְעַד לְמֵאִישׁ‎ 2Sam 6:19; 2Chr 15:13, גָּדוֺל וְעַד לְמִקָּטֹן‎ 2Kin 23:2; Jer 42:8, simil. 2Chr 15:13; Jer 31:34; Est 1:5, 20, וְעַדטֿוֺב לְמֵרָע‎ 2Sam 13:22, שָׁנָה עֶשְׂרִים לְמִבֶּן וּלְמָ֑טָּה‎ 1Chr 27:23, compare 2Chr 25:5. — On לְמִבֵּית‎ Num 18:7. (2) of time (often following by עַד‎), ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר הַיּוֺם לְמִן‎ from the day when . . ., Deut 4:32; 9:7; 2Sam 7:11 (|| 1Chr 17:10 אֲשֶׁר וּלְמִיָּמִים‎) Jer 7:25; 32:31; Hag 2:18; ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר הַיָּמִים לְמִקְצָת‎ Dan 1:18; הַיּוֺם לְמִן‎ followed by infinitive (in apposition) Exod 9:18; 2Sam 19:25; לְמִיּוֺם‎ followed by infinitive (genitive) Judg 19:30; 2Sam 7:6; Isa 7:17; ֗֗֗ לְמִימֵי‎ 2Kin 19:25 (|| Isa 37:26 מימי‎) Mal 3:7; למןֿ עולם ועד עולם‎ Jer 7:7; 25:5; לְמֵרָחוֺק‎ from afar = long before, 2Sam 7:19 = 1Chr 17:17; 2Kin 19:25 = Isa 37:26.

מְנָאוֺת‎ see מְנָת‎ below מנה‎. below

[מַנְגִּינָה‎] see נגן‎.

II. מִנֵּי מִנִּי,‎ see מִן‎. מִנִּי‎ Psa 45:9 see I. [ מֵן‎].

מִנָיוֺת‎ see מְנָת‎ below מנה‎.

מִנְיָמִן מִנְיָמִין,‎ see מִיָּמִן‎.

מִנְלָם‎ see [ מִנְלֶה‎] below נלה‎.

H5923. ol

עֹל‎39 noun masculine1Kin 12:4 yoke; — ׳ע‎ absolute Hosea 11:4 +; construct Isa 9:3 +; suffix עֻלֵךְ‎ Jer 2:20; Isa 47:6, עֻלּוֺ‎ Gen 27:40 +, עֻלְּכֶם‎ 1Kin 12:11, etc.; — yoke, for cattle, ׳ע עֲלֵיהֶם עָלָה‎ 1Sam 6:7, compare Num 19:2 (P), בְּע ׳מָֽשְׁכָה‎ Deut 21:3; usually figurative of servitude 1Kin 12:4, 10, 11 (twice in verse); 12:14 (twice in verse) = 2Chr 10:4, 10, 11 (twice in verse); 10:14; ע ׳נָתַן עַל‎ 1Kin 12:4, 9 2Chr 10:4, 9; עַלצַֿוָּארֶ֑ךָ בַּרְזֶל ע ׳וְנָתַן‎ Deut 28:48, so Jer 28:14; ע הִכְבַּדְתְּ ׳עַלזָֿקִן‎ Isa 47:6; also בְּעֹל אֶתצַֿוָּארוֺ (הֵבִיא) נָתַן‎ Jer 27:8, 11, 12; ע ׳שָׁבַר‎ break the yoke 2:20; 5:5; 28:2, 4, 11; 30:8 ( + צ ׳מֵעַל‎), so ע ׳מֹטֹת‎ Lev 26:13 (H), Ezek 34:27 (see מוֺטָה‎); ע ׳מָּרַק‎ Gen 27:40 (J; + צ ׳מֵעַל‎); ע ׳הֵחֵת‎ Isa 9:3; compare ע ׳הֵרִים‎ Hosea 11:4; also ע ׳יָסוּר צ ׳מֵעַל‎ Isa 10:27, and 14:25; figurative of transgressions Lam 1:14, strike out ᵑ9 ᵐ5 ׳ע‎ Löhr Bu, but read עֹל‎ vb (see id.); of hardship, ע ׳נָשָׂא‎ 3:27.

עלומים.def:

I. עָם עַם,‎1840

noun masculineGen 11:6 (see below) people (Late Hebrew id., plebeian, common man; עַמָּא ᵑ7‎ people, plural peoples, tribes, etc.; Syriac ; Arabic see above; original meaning probably those united, connected, related, compare WeGGN 1893, 480); — absolute עַם‎ 11:6 +, עָם‎ Judg 9:36 +, הָעָם‎ Josh 8:11 +; construct עַם‎ Num 21:29 +; suffix עַמִּי‎ Exod 3:7 +, עַמְּךָ‎ 22:27 +, etc.; plural עַמִּים‎ Isa 2:3 +, עֲמָמִים‎ (compare Biblical Aramaic) Neh 9:22; construct עַמֵּי‎ 1Kin 8:43 +, עַמְמֵי‎ Neh 9:24; plural with suffix see II. עַם‎; — (Thes cites following as feminine עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְחָטָאת‎ Exod 5:16 [but corrupt and unintellig.; read perhaps לְע ׳וְחַטָאתָ‎, so ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Di]; Judg 18:7 [but ישֶׁבֶת‎ must agree with lost word city, or the like, see GFM]; Jer 8:5 [but read שׁוֺבַב‎ for שׁוֺבְבָה‎ Gie]); —

1 a people, nation (sometimes || גּוֺי‎), collective noun (singular Exod 21:8; Josh 17:14-15, 17; 2Sam 17:29 +? Exod 20:15; 24:2; Jer 5:31 +? Exod 1:20; 2Sam 13:24): אֶחָד עַם‎ = all mankind Gen 11:6 (J); peoples in General 27:29 (J; || לְאֻמִּים‎), Exod 19:5 (E), Deut 2:25; 4:6 +? Deuteronomy; Neh 13:24 + often; עַמִּים קְהַל‎ Gen 28:3 (P) an assembly (multitude) of peoples, 48:4 (P), Ezek 23:24; 32:3 (+ רַבִּים‎); one's own people Jer 46:16; Psa 45:11; Ruth 1:10, 15, 16 (twice in verse) + (on נָדִיב עַמִּי‎ Song 6:12 see especially Bu); particular peoples, Egypt Gen 41:40 (E), Exod 1:22 (E), Neh 9:10 +; עַםאֲֿרָם‎ Amos 1:5; עַםכְּֿמוֺשׁ‎ (i.e. Moab) Num 21:29 (JE), Jer 48:46; but especially Israel Exod 1:20 (E) + often; יִשׂ ׳עַםבְּֿנֵי‎ 1:9 (J); called ׳ע יהוה‎ Num 11:29 (E), 1Sam 2:24 +, and (by ׳י‎) עַמִּי‎ Exod 3:7; 5:1 (J) + often (all periods); עַםהָֿאֱלֹהִים קְהַל‎ Judg 20:2, עַםהַֿקָּהָל‎ Lev 16:33 (P), עָם קְהַל‎ Psa 107:32; especially הַזֶּה הָעָם‎ (often in contempt or disgust) Num 11:1, 12, 13 +; figurative of ants Prov 30:25, the shaphan 30:26, locusts Joel 2:2, compare לְצִיִּים לְעַם‎ Psa 74:14 (where read צִיִּים לְעַם‎ Hup-Now). — On Judg 1:16 see עֲמָלֵקִי‎. 2 = smaller units, e.g.

a. inhabitants of a city Gen 19:4 (J), 1Sam 9:12-13, Jer 29:16, 25; 2Chr 31:4 + (Jer 8:5 strike out ᵐ5 ׳יְרוּוּשׁ‎ Gie Co Rothst).

b. inhabitants of a locality Jer 37:12 [apparently not = tribe, Deut 33:3 read ᵐ5 עַמּוֺ‎ Di Dr, Hosea 10:14; Judg 5:8, 14 read בְּעָרֶיךָ‎ We Now; see below ד‎].

c. retainers, followers Gen 14:16; 32:8; 33:15; 35:6; Judg 3:18; 8:5; 2Sam 15:17; Jer 41:13-14, +.

d. people bearing arms 1Sam 11:11; 1Kin 20:10 +; ׳ע כָּבֵד‎ Num 20:20 (JE), i.e. a powerful force; הַצָּבָא עַם‎ 31:32 (P), ׳ע הַמִּלְחָמָה‎ Josh 8:1, 3, 11; 10:7; 11:7 (all J E); so probably Judg 5:8 a (fighting) band; perhaps also 5:14 (read singular ? see GFM Bu).

3 = common people Jer 21:7; 22:4; Lev 4:27 (opposed to ruler 4:22), Neh 5:1 (opposed to יְהוּדִים‎), 7:5 (opposed to rulers).

4 people in General, persons Gen 50:20 (E), so apparently וגו אֲשֶׁר ׳כָּלהָֿעָם‎ Exod 33:16 (J), Num 11:34 (J), Josh 5:5 (twice in verse) (D), Judg 9:36 (as singular), 9:37 (as plural), Jer 36:9; persons labouring 1Kin 9:23; superior persons Job 12:2 (iron.); עוֺלָם עַם‎ Ezekiel 26:30 people of long ago (now in Sh®°ôl).

5 phrases are:

a. (עַמְּךָ עַמִּי, עַמָּהּ,‎) עַמּוֺ בְּנֵי‎ members of one's people, compatriots, fellow-countrymen, etc. Num 22:5 (E), Gen 23:11 (P) Lev 19:18 (H), Judg 14:16-17, Ezek 33:2, 12 +.

b. הָעָם בְּנֵי‎ = common people (see

3) 2Kin 23:6; Jer 26:23 +; people in General הָעָם בְּנֵי שַׁעַר‎ 17:19 i.e. public gate2Chr 35:5, 12.

c. הָאָרֶץ עַם‎ the people at large, as a body 2Kin 11:14, 18, 19, 20; 15:5; 16:15; 21:24 (twice in verse) +, Jer 37:2; 44:21; Lev 20:2 (H), Gen 23:7, 12, 13 (P); common people Jer 34:19, compare ע ׳דַּלַּת ׳הא‎ 2Kin 24:14; distinguished from prince Ezek 45:22; 46:3, 9, from priests Hag 2:4; Zech 7:5; = Canaanites Num 14:9 (JE), compare הָאָרֶץ עַמֵּי‎ 1Chr 5:25; mixed post-exile population Ezra 4:4.

d. הָאָרֶץ עַמֵּי‎ usually peoples of the earth Josh 4:24 (D), 2Chr 32:19 +; of heathen peoples about and in Palestine after exile Ezra 10:2, 11; traders Neh 10:31; הָאֲרָצוֺת עַמֵּי‎ 9:30; 10:29; 2Chr 32:13.

e. עַמִּים מִשְׁמְּחוֺת‎ Psa 96:7 = 1Chr 16:28 (compare Psa 22:28).

f. בַּתעַֿמִּי‎ = people personified Isa 22:4; Jer 4:11 7t. Jeremiah + 6:14 (van d. H.; omit בַּת‎ Baer Gi), Lam 2:11; 3:48; 4:3, 6, 10; בַּתעַֿמִּי בְּתוּלַת‎ Jer 14:17.

g. designations of Israel are: עַםקָֿרוֺשׁ‎ Deut 7:6 3t., ׳ע קְדוֺשִׁים‎ Dan 8:24, ׳ע (ה)קֹדֶשׁ‎ Isa 62:12; 63:18; Dan 12:7; ׳ע סְגֻלָּה‎ Deut 7:6; 14:2; 26:18.

h. of foreign (non-Israel) peoples: נָכְרִי ׳ע‎ Exod 21:8 (E), ׳ע אַחֵר‎ Deut 28:32, and especially from language, ׳ע שָׂפָה עִמְקֵי‎ Ezek 3:5 compare 3:6, וָעָם עַם כִּלְשׁוֺן‎ Neh 13:24 compare Est 1:22 (twice in verse); 3:12, ׳ע לֹעֵג‎ Psa 114:1.

i. עֶבְרָתִי עַם‎ Isa 10:6, ׳ע חֶרְמִי‎ 34:11, מִֿבְחָרָיו׳ע‎ Dan 11:15, הָאֵלֶּה תּוֺעֵבוֺת עַמֵּי‎ Ezra 9:14; בִּינוֺת עַם לֹא‎ Isa 27:11. — For עַםעֿוֺלָם‎ 44:7 read (אֹתִיּוֺת‎) מֵעוֺלָם הִשְׁמִי)עַ (מִי‎ Oort Du Kit CheHpt compare PerlesAnal. 40, 64.

II. [עַם‎] noun [masculine] kinsman **later development of I. עַם‎ RSK 58; 2nd ed. 72. (on father's side) (Arabic paternal uncle, etc., see I. עמם‎; compare perhaps Tel Amarna ammu, kinsmen (?); on Nabataean עם‎ ancestor compare Lzb151, 499; see also especially NesEg 187, ZAW xvi (1896), 322f. Krenkelib. viii (1888), 280-84); — suffix עַמִּי‎ in בֶּןעַֿמִּי‎ (q. v.), and proper name following; elsewhere plural suffix עַמֶּיךָ‎ Num 27:13; 31:2 (Lev 19:16 read ⅏ ᵐ5 עַמְּךָ‎), + (possibly) עֲמָָמֶיךָ‎ Judg 5:14; עַמָּיו‎ Gen 25:8 15t., עַמֶּיהָ‎ 17:14 3t.; read עַמֶּי‎ (for עַמִּי ᵑ0‎, I. עַם‎; compare Krenkell.c. 281) 49:29 and perhaps Judg 14:3 (compare Lev 21:14); according to Buhl Kit also 2Kin 4:13; — father's kinsmen: אֶלעַֿמָּיו וַיֵּאָסֵף‎ Gen 25:8 (of joining kinsmen in Sh®°ôl), so 25:17; 35:29; 49:33; Num 20:24; Deut 32:50, compare Gen 49:29 (see above), Num 27:13; 31:2; Deut 32:50 (all P); מֵעַמֶּיהָ הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְנִכְרְתָה‎ Gen 17:4 (severed from living kinsmen), so Lev 7:20-21, 23, 27; 19:8; 23:29; Num 9:13, עַמֶּיהָ מִקֶּרֶב‎ Exod 31:14, compare 30:33, 38; Lev 17:9 (all PH); אִשָּׁה יִקַּח מֵעַמָּיו‎ 21:14 (H), and perhaps Judg 14:3 (simile I. עַם‎: [הָּ֯ םָ֯,‎] עַמּוֺ מִקֶּרֶב‎ Lev 17:4, 10; 18:29+); other combinations Judg 5:14 (si vera lectio read perhaps בְּעַמֶּ֑ךָ‎, see I. עַם‎ 2d ), Lev 21:1, 4, 15 (H), Ezek 18:18 and (perhaps) 2Kin 4:13. — בֶּןעַֿמִּי‎ perhaps = son of my kinsman; on proper name with עַם‎ see GrayProp. N. 41 ff.

עַם‎ noun masculineEzra 6:12 people (see Biblical Hebrew I. עַם עמם,‎); — ׳ע‎ absolute Dan 2:44; 3:29; Ezra 6:12, construct Dan 7:27; emphatic עַמָּה‎ Ezra 5:12, עַמָּא‎ 7:13, 16, 25; plural emphatic עַמֲמַיָּא‎ (K§§ 15d); 55, 5 a)) Dan 3:4, 7 (twice in verse); Daniel 3:31; 5:19; 6:26; 7:14.

עמד.def:
H5975. amad

עָמַד‎520 take one's stand, stand (Late Hebrew id.; Phoenician עמד‎; Assyrian emêdu, stand, set up; Arabic prop up, support, and derivatives; Ethiopic pillar; עַמּוּדָא ᵑ7‎ pillar, Syriac , Palmyrene עמודא‎, compare also proper name תימעמד‎; Sabean עמד‎ pillar, according to CISiv. 91 (or other derivatives from √ עמד‎ DHMZMG xxxvii (1883), 5), plural אעמדן‎ pillars DHMEpigr. Denkm. sus Abess. 80); —

Qal435 Perfect ׳ע‎ Gen 19:27 +, 3 feminine singular עָֽמְדָה‎ 2Kin 13:6 +, etc.; Imperfect יַעֲמֹד‎ Exod 21:21, יַעֲמוֺד‎ Nahum 1:6 +, יַעֲמָדֿ‎ 1Sam 16:22 +; 1 singular אֶעֱמֹ֑דָה‎ Hab 2:1, וָאֶעֱמֹד‎ 2Sam 1:10; 3masculine plural יַעַמְדוּ‎ Jer 32:14 +, יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ‎ Ezek 1:21 +, 2 masculine plural וַתַּעַמְדוּן‎ Deut 4:11, etc.; Imperative עֲמֹד‎ 1Sam 9:27 +, עֲמָדֿ‎ 2Sam 1:9; feminine singular עִמְדִי‎ Isa 47:12; Jer 48:19, etc.; Infinitive absolute עָמֹד‎ Est 9:16; construct עֲמֹד‎ Exod 18:23 +, suffix עָמְדִי‎ Jer 18:20, עֲמָדְךָ‎ Obadiah 11, etc.; Participle עֹמֵד‎ Isa 3:13 +, feminine עֹמֶ֫דֶת‎ Hag 2:5 +, etc.; —

1. a. take one's stand, and (especially participle) stand, be in a standing attitude: with עַל‎ by, 1Sam 26:13; 2Sam 2:25; 2Kin 2:7 +, so participle Gen 18:8 (J), 41:1, 17 (E) +, עַל‎ on, Exod 3:5 (E), Deut 27:12 +; with ב‎ location Exod 32:26; Num 22:24, 26 (all J E), +; with אֶל‎ location 1Kin 20:38 (+ לְ‎ person), Jer 48:19; Ezek 21:26; 27:29; with אֶל‎ person 1Sam 17:51; 2Kin 5:25; with אֵצֶל‎ Gen 41:3 (E), Ezek 9:2; 10:6; Neh 8:4; with לִפְנֵי‎ Gen 18:22; 1Kin 3:16; 8:22 +; before ׳י‎, for intercession Gen 19:27 (J), Deut 4:10; Jer 15:1; 18:20, etc.; take one's stand and do a thing 1Sam 17:8; 1Kin 8:55; 2Kin 18:28 = Isa 36:13 +; followed by infinitive 1Kin 8:11 2Chr 5:14 +.

b. stand forth (to speak, etc.) 2Kin 10:9 +.

c. take a stand against (עַל‎), in opposition to, Judg 6:31; Ezra 10:15 (but stand over, = have charge of, according to KueGes. Abh. 247 f.) 2Chr 26:18; compare עַלדַּֿם‎ Lev 19:16 (H) against the blood of, i.e. seek one's blood, life; with יָ֑חַד‎ Isa 50:8 together, i.e. against each other.

d. present oneself before (לִפְנֵי‎) Gen 43:15 (J), Exod 9:10 (E), Num 27:2, 21 (P), 1Sam 16:21 +; before ׳י‎ (in sanctuary) Deut 19:17; Jer 7:10; compare 18:20; Lev 9:5 (P); so in heaven 1Kin 22:21 2Chr 18:20; with ב‎ location of child at birth Hosea 13:13, in palace (as retainer, courtier) Dan 1:4

e. with לִפְנֵי‎ attend upon, be(come) servant of 1Sam 16:22 (see Dr), 1Kin 1:2 +; servant of ׳י‎ 17:1; 18:15; 2Kin 3:14; 5:16; Jer 15:19; priests י (לְשָֽׁרְתוֺׅ׳לִפְנֵי‎ Deut 10:8; Judg 20:28; Ezek 44:15; 2Chr 29:11; of Levites, stand before congregation for menial duties Ezek 44:11; Num 16:9 (P).

f. stand afar מֵרָחוֺק‎ Exod 20:18, 21 (E), Isa 59:14; Psa 38:12, ׳בְּר‎ 10:1; מֵר ׳מִנֶּגֶד‎ 2Kin 2:7; stand aloof, מִנֶֹּגֶד‎ Obadiah 11; Psa 38:12.

g. stand (silent) Job 32:16.

h. stand (appealingly) Job 30:20 (but read עָמַדְתָּ‎, of God, Me Hi Du).

i. stand, subject רֶגֶל‎ Zech 14:4 (עַל‎ location), Psa 122:2 (ב‎ location) so 26:12 (figurative).

j. stand, of water, עַלהָֿרִים‎ Psa 104:6. See also prepositions עִם מִמַּעַל, עַל, אֵצֶל, אֶל,‎, etc.

2. a. stand still, stop, cease moving, of moon Josh 10:13 (J E; || וַיִּדֹּם‎), sun 10:13, both, Hab 3:11; of person 1Sam 9:27 (opposed to עָבַר‎), 2Sam 2:28 (opposed to רָדַף‎), עֲמֹ֫דוּ עִמְדוּ‎ Nahum 2:9 +; stop flowing (of oil) 2Kin 4:6; remain standing, with תַּחְתֵּינוּ‎ Judg 7:21; 1Sam 14:9 etc.; of eruption in skin = remain unchanged Lev 13:23, 28; so (without ׳ת‎) 13:5, 37 (all P).

b. = be inactive 2Chr 20:17 (opposed to לְהִלָּחֵם‎, + הִתְיַצְּבוּ‎).

c. = be attentive Job 37:14.

d. stop, cease doing a thing 2Kin 13:18; with מִן‎ Gen 29:35; 30:9 (both J), Joel 1:15.

3. a. tarry, delay Gen 45:9 (E), Josh 10:19 (J E; opposed to רָדַף‎), 1Sam 20:38 (opposed to חוּשָׁה מְהֵרָה,‎), +.

b. remain, with ב‎ location 2Kin 15:20; Deut 10:10; with עִמָּדִי‎ 5:28 (opposed to שׁוּב‎); + infinitive purpose Est 7:7.

c. continue, abide Jer 32:14; Isa 66:22; Psa 102:27 (opposed to אָבַד‎); = dwell Exod 8:18 (J; עַל‎ location); לָעַד‎ Psa 19:10; 111:3; 111:10; 112:3; 112:9; לְעוֺלָם‎ 33:11; Eccl 1:4; בְּתוֺךְ‎ Hag 2:5; of plan = be established Psa 33:11 (earlier קוּם‎, as Isa 14:24), so Est 3:4; Dan 11:17 b; = maintain itself (earlier קוּם‎ Josh 2:11) Eccl 2:9; כֹחַ יַעֲמָדבִּֿי לֹא‎ Dan 10:17.

d. endure Exod 18:23 (E), Ezek 22:14 (|| חָזַק‎).

e. be steadfast Deut 25:8; Ruth 2:7.

f. persist Eccl 8:3.

4 make a stand, hold one's ground, Amos 2:15; 2Kin 10:4; Mal 3:2 +; with לִפְנֵי‎ Judg 2:14; 2Kin 10:4 +, בִּפְנֵי‎ Josh 10:8; 21:44 (Ginsb; van d. H. Baer 21:42), 23:9 (all D); with עַל‎, for one's life Est 8:11; 9:16.

5 stand upright:

a. remain standing 2Kin 13:6; of head 6:31 remain upright upon him (עָלָיו‎); of house (figurative of endurance) Job 8:15; Prov 12:7.

b. stand up, opposed to sit, Neh 8:5; Job 29:8 (+ קוּם‎); opposed to lie prostrate Ezek 2:1 (עַלרַֿגְלֶיךָ‎), so 37:10 (id.), Dan 10:1, 10:11 (עַלעָֿמְדָ֑ךָ‎), Est 8:4; of revival after death Dan 12:13 (late for קוּם‎).

c. stand up, rise, of water Josh 3:13 (+ appositive אֶחָד נֵד‎), 3:16 (+ קָמוּ‎ + id.; both J E).

d. be erect, upright, of boards Exod 26:15; 36:20 (P).

6. a. arise, appear, come on the scene (= קוּם‎; late) Ezra 2:63 = Neh 7:65; Psa 106:30 (compare Ecclus 47:1; Ecclus 47:12), especially Dan 8:22 (twice in verse); 8:23; 11:2-3, 4; 12:1, compare 11:7 (כַּנּוֺ‎), 11:20; 11:21 (עַלכַּֿנּוֺ‎); with תַּחַת‎ instead of Eccl 4:15; of war 1Chr 20:4, deliverance Est 4:14.

b. stand forth, appear = come into being Isa 48:13; Psa 33:9; 119:90.

c. rise up as foe (earlier קום‎ Amos 7:9; Gen 4:8), with עַל‎ against 1Chr 21:1; 2Chr 20:23; Dan 8:25; 11:14,

c. לְנֶגְדִּי‎ against Dan 10:13.

7 rare usages are:

a. ׳ע אֶתֿ‎ stand with, as attendant, servitor Gen 45:1 (E), Num 1:5 (P).

b. take one's stand in covenant, בַּבְּרִית‎ 2Kin 23:3.

c. stand עַלחֶֿרֶב‎ Ezek 33:26 (resort to the sword).

d. stand י ׳בְּסוֺד‎ Jer 23:18, 22 (see סוֺד‎).

e. be appointed Ezra 10:14.

f. stand before (לִפְנֵי‎) beast Lev 18:23 (carnal intercourse)

g. grow flat, insipid (Gie), taste of wine Jer 48:11 (figurative of Moab), or remain unchanged (so most, in that case compare 3b). — עָמְדִי‎ Dan 11:1b is corrupt, read probably עָמַדְתִּי‎, or עָמַד‎ (מִיכָאֵל‎ subject), join then to 10:21 and strike out 11:1a; so Bev Behrm MartiKau.

Hiph`il83 (compare DrIntr. (6) 535) Perfect3masculine singular הֶעֱמִיד‎ 1Kin 12:32 +, 2 masculine singular הֶעֱמַדְתָּה‎ Psa 30:8, וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ֫‎ Num 3:6 +, etc., Imperfect יַעֲמִיד‎ Prov 29:4 +, וַיַּעֲמֵד‎ 2Kin 8:1 +; 3 feminine singular suffix וַתַּעֲמִדֵנִי‎ Ezek 2:2; 3:24, 1plural וַנַּעֲמִיד‎ Neh 4:3, etc.; Imperative הַעֲמֵד‎ Isa 21:6; suffix הַעֲמִידֶהָ‎ Ezek 24:11; Infinitive absolute הַעֲמֵיד‎ Neh 7:3; construct הַעֲמִיד‎ 1Kin 15:4 +; Participle מַעֲמִיד‎2Chr 18:34 (but see Hoph`al): —

1 station, set, with accusative Judg 16:25 (בֵּין‎); for duty Num 11:24 (E; סְבִיבֹת‎) 1Kin 12:32 (ב‎ location), 2Chr 19:5 (id.), Neh 13:11(עָמְדָם עַלֿ‎), Isa 21:6 + (Neh 4:7 a read perhaps

Qal, so PerlesAnal. 65), with עַל‎ against Neh 4:3.

2 cause to stand firm Psa 18:34 = 2Sam 22:34 (with עַל‎ location); maintain (opposed to overthrow) Exod 9:16 (J), 1Kin 15:4, compare Prov 29:4.
